2.3.20 Report.EmbeddedImages
The Report.EmbeddedImages element specifies the images that are embedded within a Report.
This element is optional. This element is of type EmbeddedImages.
Following is the parent element of the Report.EmbeddedImages element.
Parent elements
Report
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Report.EmbeddedImages element.
 <xsd:element name="EmbeddedImages" type="EmbeddedImagesType" minOccurs="0" />
